answered</h2>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">1</span><div><h3>&ldquo;How do tastings work, what do they cost, and do we need to book?&rdquo;</h3><p>Raised in 586 reviews. Chukker explains that no reservation is needed, walks guests through the flights, guided tastings and seated tastings with your published prices, and reminds them that the last tasting is at 5&nbsp;p.m.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"Do we need a reservation for a tasting?\" aria-label=\"Ask Chukker: Do we need a reservation for a tasting?\">Ask Chukker</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">2</span><div><h3>&ldquo;Is there polo this Sunday, and what should we bring?&rdquo;</h3><p>Raised in 505 reviews. Chukker shares the season, from Memorial Day weekend through October, when the gates open and the match begins, where to check the match status that morning, and what to pack. Between seasons, Chukker says the 2027 dates aren&rsquo;t posted yet.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"Is there polo this Sunday?\" aria-label=\"Ask Chukker: Is there polo this Sunday?\">Ask Chukker</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">3</span><div><h3>&ldquo;What food is here, and can we bring a picnic?&rdquo;</h3><p>Raised in 344 reviews. There is no restaurant, so Chukker says picnics are welcome, points to the gift shop&rsquo;s snacks and the seasonal food trucks, and mentions that outside alcohol isn&rsquo;t allowed.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"Can we bring a picnic?\" aria-label=\"Ask Chukker: Can we bring a picnic?\">Ask Chukker</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">4</span><div><h3>&ldquo;Can we save a spot for our group?&rdquo;</h3><p>Raised in 329 reviews. Seating is first come, first served, so Chukker points groups of 10 or more to the patio near the polo barn, asks groups of 20 or more to call ahead, and passes larger plans to your team.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"We're a group of 14 for a birthday. Where can we sit?\" aria-label=\"Ask Chukker: We&rsquo;re a group of 14 for a birthday. Where can we sit?\">Ask Chukker</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">5</span><div><h3>&ldquo;We&rsquo;re getting married. What&rsquo;s included, and what if it rains?&rdquo;</h3><p>Raised in 247 reviews. Chukker shares the indoor and outdoor spaces and the Carriage House, which holds more than 200 guests, then sends the couple&rsquo;s date and guest count to your events team for pricing, rain plans and a private tour.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"We're thinking about getting married here. Where do we start?\" aria-label=\"Ask Chukker: We&rsquo;re thinking about getting married here. Where do we start?\">Ask Chukker</button></div>\n</div></section>\n\n<section class=\"voices\"><div class=\"wrap\">\n<span class=\"lab red\">From your newest reviews</span>\n<h2>Your guests are still asking.</h2>\n<p class=\"nl\">Four recent posts, in your guests&rsquo; own words. if(lb&&wfb){var lbi=lb.querySelector('img');function lbclose(){lb.hidden=true;document.body.style.overflow='';try{wfb.focus()}catch(e){}}
wfb.addEventListener('click',function(){lbi.src=wfb.querySelector('img').src;lb.hidden=false;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';lb.querySelector('[data-lbclose]').focus()});
lb.querySelector('[data-lbclose]').addEventListener('click',lbclose);
lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===lb)lbclose()});
lb.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();if(e.key==='Escape')lbclose()}});}
md.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===md)mclose()});
md.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.stopPropagation();mclose();return}if(e.key==='Tab'){var f=md.querySelectorAll('a[href],button');var a=f[0],z=f[f.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===a){e.preventDefault();z.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===z){e.preventDefault();a.focus()}}});
})();
})();
